English:[/b][/u]

Who did not want to pull his own saplings.
Now possible with my cabinet.

The Recipe sells Pierre (50000 Gold) in year 3.
It needs 1 Fruit, 10x standard fertilizer and after 2 weeks the sapling is
ready.

The quality of the fruit give you a extra chance for a second sapling.

Silver Star 10%
Gold Star 50%
Iridium Star 100%

3. Install Json Assets
